author: ingolf-lohmann
body:
Objective: evolve the repository into a self-improving engineering agent.

Tasks:
1. Inventory all repository capabilities.
2. Produce a machine-readable capability matrix.
3. Detect missing capabilities automatically.
4. Implement missing capabilities incrementally.
5. Add a repository-native mechanism to inventory its own structure (current gap).
6. Repeat inventory -> gap detection -> implementation -> verification until no core capability gaps remain.
7. Mirror validated milestones to ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt.

Acceptance:
- Capability matrix committed.
- Self-inventory implemented.
- Automated gap detection documented.
- All changes verified by tests before promotion.
title: Bootstrap Repository Capability Supervisor and Self-Inventory
